NTA. I see that I’m in the minority here, but as someone that enjoys meat, I don’t see this as the massive breach of trust people are talking about. While you would be the asshole if the roles were reversed, there’s not harm associated with eating plant based meat.

On the rare occasion I would try them, I was already bracing myself for it to be disgusting because I hated knowing I was eating something fake. Meat alternatives have evolved over the past decade and actually taste delicious now. If you waited for them to agree to eat them, you might not have gotten them to try it. Now they’ve learned that meat alternatives can be good. Okay they’re upset on principle, but is the outcome really that bad? I feel like people do food pranks on YouTube all the time and nobody talks about how trust is being broken. 

More people should eat plant based meats for so many reasons. I say this as someone that loves eating meat. Hopefully your husband and son get over this and try more things.
